title: Support Charter 2027: What the Support Agent May and May Not Do
author: Dev Patel
body:
## Purpose
This charter is the source of truth for what the support agent may and may not do. It takes precedence over proposals, drafts, Slack threads, and older pages where they disagree.

## Credits and disputes
- Support can issue duplicate-charge credit notes only on self-serve accounts.
- Support may not issue a credit note of any amount on an account with a signed contract (Enterprise).
- For a confirmed duplicate on a contract account, open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. Billing Ops applies contract-account adjustments under the contract.

## What does not change
- Everything else in Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2) still applies, as does the billing case routing and handoffs page. Both are linked above.

## What changes Support's authority
- Proposals, drafts and Slack threads don't change Support's authority. Only a published charter revision does.

## Scope
This charter covers the support agent and every human working the support queue, in every channel. Team procedures (credits and disputes, routing, card data) say how to do each thing; this page says whether Support may do it at all.

## Support may
- Look up a customer's billing account, invoices, usage and credits in the console, and answer from them.
- Explain billing behaviour from the published pages.
- Issue a duplicate-charge credit note on a self-serve account, within the limit Finance sets.
- Open a dispute on a duplicated line.
- Open a case with the team the routing page names, and tell the customer who has it.

## Support may not
- Issue goodwill, SLA or exception credits, or any refund.
- Promise an amount, an outcome or a date for something another team decides.
- Change payment methods or take card numbers.
- Quote figures from a customer's contract.
- Change a customer's plan, limits or reservation.

## Revisions
The charter is reviewed every six months by the Director of Customer Support with Finance and Security. A revision is published here with its date; until then the current text applies.

_Last reviewed 2027-03-24._
